item.title: Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea; at least six dead, 130 missing
item.description: At least six people have died and 130 remain missing after an Indonesian passenger ferry capsized in the Java Sea in bad weather, authorities said Sunday. item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack from Iraq
item.description: Saudi Arabia has shut down a critical oil pipeline after it was attacked by drones launched from Iraq, as conflict in the Middle East widens and Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen make major military gains.
